request.answer: Customer will pay Provider an annual subscription fee of $148,000 for the Service, invoiced annually in advance. Provider retains all right, title and interest in the Service, excluding configurations, integrations and improvements developed in connection with this Agreement, which will be owned by Customer upon creation. Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach if the breach is not cured within thirty (30) days after written notice. Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time on thirty (30) days' written notice and will receive a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. Any separate attempt to assign is void.

request.instructions: The source is one version of an agreement. Each claim is a sentence taken from the other version of the same agreement. A claim is supported when the source states the same obligation, right, amount, rate, period, party and place, even if the wording, spelling, punctuation or number formatting differs. A claim is contradicted when the source states something different about any of those. Judge each claim against the passage of the source that covers the same subject.
